claims.text: The driver's headline figure is the wrong field. POL-RD-01 provides that where gps_trace.trace_distance_km and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree, the trace governs and actual_distance_km may not be cited for the threshold test. The trace records 11.43 km against a 9.5 km optimal, an excess of 1.93 km — 20.32% — so the driver's 'exactly 20 percent' submission is built on the rounded convenience copy the clause forbids citing, and the straddle is precisely the case the clause's trace-governs sentence was written for. The deviation is ESTABLISHED on the governing figure.

Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass on the trace. The excess is 1.93 km, greater than the 0.8 km absolute floor, and 20.32% of the 9.5 km optimal, greater than the 20% proportional gate. Because both tests pass, no deviation-excusing clause is needed for the claim to succeed — and none is available to the driver in any event.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip identifier TRP-00303 and describe the same trip window, and limb (b) is satisfied because the excess is measured from a gps_trace that is unimpaired. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who has pointed to no artifact and no clause that excuses the excess.

No additional corroboration is demanded of the rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 tightening that bites only at 4 or more claims in 60 days with 1 or fewer substantiated is not engaged, and the trace evidence stands on its own.

The trace is clean, so the POL-RD-07 integrity consequences never arise. It carries 106 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds — so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires, the deviation may be established on the gps_trace alone, and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The driver cannot run a rider-requested-detour exoneration. The chat log for this trip holds 0 messages and no first or last message timestamp, so there is no rider instruction that could satisfy POL-RD-04(a) to (c) and no distance is excludable on that ground. The clause is simply not in play.

The driver cannot run a relocation exoneration either. Neither pickup_amended_at nor dropoff_amended_at is set on the trip record, the original pickup and dropoff are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are null, so there is no amended route for POL-RD-05 to re-apply POL-RD-01 against and nothing to exclude.

No closure or traffic exoneration is available. EV-ADVIS-00303-01 is the traffic advisory artifact and it is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and its own issue detail records that no advisory covers this corridor in this window. The absence is citable and it defeats the comparison POL-RD-03 requires, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the driver's assertion that he 'took Upper Serangoon then Bendemeer as normal', which names no advisory id, carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because no advisory identifier is cited by the driver, the absent artifact is a gap in the bundle and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), per POL-RD-13.

With the deviation established and no clause excusing it, the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 and the fare model is METERED, so the clause runs rather than POL-RD-11. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.5 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 15.365; charged_total is 18.05; the refund is 2.685, rounded up to SGD 2.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so NO_ACTION is not available to the driver, and it is far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND rather than FULL_REFUND.

No pass-through line needs separate correction and no billing-integrity referral arises. erp_gantries is empty, tolls and ERP are 0.00, there is no airport surcharge on a trip running Hougang Mall to Novena Square, and waiting_time_fee is 0.00 — so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and there is no unmatched charge line to refer.

This is not the mutually contradictory evidence POL-RD-10(7) describes, and no escalation trigger fires. The only tension in the bundle is between the trace and the rounded copy of the same measurement, and POL-RD-01 resolves that by rule, not by weighing comparable evidence; the rider's excess is measured from an unimpaired trace, the trip identifiers match, the timestamps do not run backwards, and the POL-RD-02 refund is neither above SGD 150.00 nor above charged_total. The record permits a final ruling.

The evidence is not 'finely balanced' in the sense that needs rescuing, and the driver_profile check produces nothing for the driver in any case. The excess is 20.32% of optimal, below the 50% and 8.0 km materiality marks, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged at all; and even if it were consulted, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 260, which is not a pattern under that clause's two tests and yields neither a rider-favouring resolution nor any other adjustment.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: this is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-00303 (Hougang Mall to Novena Square). The fare charged was SGD 18.05 and the rider contests SGD 4.00. The rider is partly right.

The threshold. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on the GPS trace, not on the trip record's rounded convenience copy, and it says so expressly. The trace reads 11.43 km against a 9.5 km optimal, an excess of 1.93 km and 20.32%. Both establishment tests pass together: more than 0.8 km and more than 20%. A deviation is therefore established. The driver's submission that 11.4 km against 9.5 km is “exactly 20 percent” is arithmetically true of the 11.4 figure, but 11.4 is the rounded copy POL-RD-01 forbids citing for the threshold test; on the governing trace figure the gate is crossed by 0.32 of a percentage point. The driver's contrary argument is rejected on that ground alone.

The remedy. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.5 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 15.365. charged_total is 18.05, so the refund is 2.685, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 2.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so the driver's NO_ACTION submission fails, and it is far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND rather than FULL_REFUND. Both advocates' arithmetic on this figure agrees and is accepted.

No uplift and no referral. The excess is 20.32%, far below the 50% or 8.0 km marks for a MATERIAL deviation, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available on this trip's own evidence. Even if the profile were consulted, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 260 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established. The lifetime counters and all other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no finding. No ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time line exists on this fare (all 0.00), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and produces no billing-integrity referral. The billed-distance shortfall against the trace is 0.03 km, far below the 1.0 km that would open POL-RD-04 driver compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null.

Exculpatory grounds. The driver's account that he took Upper Serangoon then Bendemeer is an assertion that his route was normal and cites no traffic advisory. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00303-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers this corridor in this window, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The chat log is empty, so POL-RD-04 is not in play; no endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 is not in play; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and the fare is METERED, not upfront, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 — 106 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds — so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The driver's point that the fare breakdown carries no pickup-timestamp field does not defeat the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08: all three artifacts carry trip identifier TRP-00303 and the trace's first fix at 19:16:48 matches the trip record's start, so the artifacts plainly describe the same trip, and limb (b) is met from an unimpaired trace. The rider's profile does not tighten the burden (deviation_claims_60d is 0). No escal­a­tion trigger fires: identifiers match, timestamps do not run backwards, the refund is below charged_total, and the only tension in the bundle is between the trace and a rounded copy of the same measurement, which POL-RD-01 resolves by rule rather than by weighing comparable evidence.

Confidence is 0.88, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts — the GPS trace and trip record for the deviation, the fare breakdown for the refund. The monetary effect, SGD 2.70, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

THRESHOLD (POL-RD-01). Where trip_record.actual_distance_km and gps_trace.trace_distance_km disagree, the trace governs and the rounded trip-record copy may NOT be cited for the threshold test. ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns trip TRP-00303 (Hougang Mall to Novena Square, 5 Aug 2026, fare SGD 18.05). Part of the rider's fare is refunded.

THE THRESHOLD (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the GPS trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 11.43 km (EV-GPS-00303), not the trip record's rounded 11.4 km (EV-TRIP-00303), because the clause says the trace governs where the two disagree and the rounded convenience copy may not be cited for the threshold test. Against the 9.5 km optimal, that is an excess of 1.93 km — 20.32% — which passes both establishment tests (more than 20%, and more than 0.8 km). The driver's submission that 11.4 km against 9.5 km is 'exactly 20 percent' is built on the rounded copy the clause forbids citing; on the trace the deviation is established by 0.32 of a percentage point. The excess is not material (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not engaged and neither its FULL_REFUND uplift nor its conduct referral is available; the driver's own profile figures (deviation_flags_90d 0 of completed_trips_90d 260, EV-DPROF-00303) confirm no pattern in any event.

EXCULPATION. The GPS trace is clean — 106 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds — so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and no independent corroboration is required. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00303) is empty and carries no rider instruction, so POL-RD-04 is not in play; no pickup or dropoff amendment was made, so POL-RD-05 is not in play; the fare is METERED, not UPFRONT_QUOTE, so POL-RD-11 does not displace POL-RD-02; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00303-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so the closure comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run. The driver names no advisory id, so under POL-RD-13(1) the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and his 'took Upper Serangoon then Bendemeer as normal' assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

THE REFUND (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.5 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x 1.0 surge, read from EV-FARE-00303, + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 15.365; charged_total = SGD 18.05; refund before rounding = SGD 2.685, rounded UP to SGD 2.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 14.88% of charged_total, far below the 90% that would make it a full refund, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.70. Nothing is added on top: ERP and tolls are 0.00 and the gantries list is empty, the trip runs Hougang Mall to Novena Square and attracts no airport surcharge, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding pass-through lines on top of the clause 2 figure — so POL-RD-09 produces no correction and no billing-integrity referral. The refund is SGD 2.70 of the SGD 4.00 the rider contested.

THE REMAINING DISPUTED POINTS. The driver argues the rider's POL-RD-08(a) showing is incomplete because the fare breakdown carries no pickup timestamp field. I reject that: all three artifacts are keyed to trip TRP-00303 and the pickup timestamps that exist — trip_record.started_at and gps_trace.first_fix_at, both 19:16:48 — agree, and nothing in the bundle contradicts the identity of the trip; a payments ledger is not expected to carry a pickup field. The driver also observes that the rider's filed description is hedged and that no chat message exists. That is true but immaterial: the deviation is decided on the cited trace and fare artifacts, and the empty chat log only removes a detour excuse, it does not defeat the measured excess.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact (trip record, GPS trace, fare breakdown) has weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is capped at 1.0 and is set at 0.90. The monetary effect of SGD 2.70 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
